title: Ada Bench
problem: The first serious question in a pharma BD conversation is not whether the organoid is interesting. It is whether the predictor generalizes beyond the molecules and assays it was tuned on. ADA risk is dataset fragile: most published immunogenicity predictors can overfit to the limited set of approved biologics with public clinical ADA data.
direction: An open, reproducible retrospective benchmark for predicting clinical anti-drug antibody rates on FDA-approved monoclonal antibodies. The output is a partner-facing evidence pack ALP Bio can use to show where an immunogenicity predictor generalizes, where it fails, and what evidence supports the claim.
why: The judgement is which deliverable to put in the CBO's hand. A model would generate a paper; a benchmark generates meetings. For a pre seed company whose next milestone is a pharma partnership, meetings are the only metric that matters.
